facts.text: The repository is a Python device adaptor for the Zaber X-ADR130 linear motor XY microscope stage
The adaptor writes the ASCII command '/get device.id' and reads the reply before any motion
Device id 50998 is recognized as an X-ADR130B100B-SAE53D12
The constructor rejects an x limit outside 0 to 130 mm and a y limit outside 0 to 100 mm
A command is sent as '/<device address> <command>\n'; a reply begins with '@<device address>' and ends with CRLF
get_position_mm reads 'get pos' and converts each axis from nm to mm by 1e-6
An x move is sent as '1 move abs <position in nm>' and is not sent when the target is outside the configured x limits
A y move is sent as '2 move abs <position in nm>' and is not sent when the target is outside the configured y limits
get_maxspeed reads 'get maxspeed' and converts each axis to mm/s with 1e-6 / 1.6384, rounded to three decimals
set_maxspeed sends '1 set maxspeed' and '2 set maxspeed' with 1e6 * 1.6384 * mm/s
The x axis is stopped with '1 stop'
The y axis is stopped with '2 stop'
